sourceContracts: Native exact SET-only request binds one existing stable UUID and nonempty name/color strings; full original/final scene parser retains the prior 128 KiB and schema1 rules.

Native edits replace only net name/color string-value CST spans; decoded equality is byte noop, color case change is explicit intent; logical paths name then color are independent of source field order.

Bridge retains every nonstring gap/numeric byte and every key token; rejects semantic-equal token rewrites and verifies actual parsed final model equals the expected selected-object change. No new JS source parser or parser fallback.

Fourth private WeakSet brand is separate from transform/object/environment brands; shared five-field source snapshot and memory-only apply guards are reused without widening the read-only three-field preview port.

UI approval binds the visible and selected UUID, full raw signature, original proposal object/JSON and current session. Pending/closed/changed-source ownership rejects late results; receipt binds new source token/path/content.
UI preserves original decoded CR/CRLF name when the seeded textarea display is unchanged; authors retain exact whitespace/codepoints and color case. No trim or normalization.
New scoped external CSS includes hidden enforcement; no inline style, dynamic renderer, backend, World or ordinary Save authority is injected into the property controller.
Studio module is independent and boot-only; five source port option objects detach before settings await and missing/disabled property module leaves the four older 3D domains available.
